THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The Allotments of land depicted in below names and extents in the Advance Tracing No. MN/MNN/2023/577 dated 27.10.2023, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Pesalai in the Grama Niladhari Division, No. MN/56 of Pesalai South in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province and bounded as follows. :
01. Lot ‘A’ – Pesalaikaani - Extent: 1.0364 Hectares North: Pesalaikaani (claimant not known); East: Pesalaikaani (claimant not known) and Lot B; South: Lot B and Pesalaikaani
(claimant not known); West: Pesalaikaani (claimant not known).

02. Lot ‘B’ – Pesalaikaani - Extent: 0.2371 Hectare North: Lot A and Pesalaikaani (claimant not known); East: Pesalaikaani (claimant not known); South: Pesalaikaani (claimant not known); West: Pesalaikaani (claimant not known) and Lot A.
Harin Fernando Minister of Tourism and Lands.
My No.: 4-3/11/2023/RE/171.Ministry of Tourism and Lands“Mihikatha Medura”, No. 1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.14th February, 2024.
